claims.text: The graph's node schema keeps languages and scripts distinct, and no node carries a placement as a fact: language and script nodes are different record kinds joined only by time-scoped WRITES relations; every node carries exactly one subtype from the design's lists; family placement exists only as placement assertions and PROPOSED_RELATION edges; the node schema has no unqualified family field. Does not establish: that any placement assertion in the graph is correct; only that placements are represented in the one permitted form.

claims.text: The edge layer keeps the seven historical predicates mechanically distinct and preserves competition: every historical edge carries its predicate, evidence class, proponent, basis, scope, and a concrete falsifier or narrowing condition; competing edges coexist as separate records; no merge, majority, or consensus record exists that its sources do not themselves state; transitive closure is computed only within admitted GENETIC_DESCENT and never crosses PROPOSED_RELATION, contact, areal, population, script, or WRITES relations; no language relationship is derived from a script relationship, a population movement, or a rendering product. Does not establish: that any edge's asserted relationship is true; only that the layer represents each assertion in its own name.

claims.text: Geometry is typed before coordinates, and the projection never implies what the assertions do not say: every rendered coordinate resolves to a typed geometry assertion; attested and inferred geometries are stored, rendered, and exported in separate layers; NO_GEOMETRY nodes appear in the off-sphere index and never at a default coordinate; time is an interval query with no interpolation between slices; the eight never-imply rules of the design's section 3.8 hold for every view this build files. Does not establish: any geographic, homeland, or contact claim; views are renderings over a release, not evidence.
